In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|High Command]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] tasked one of its sub-groups, [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]], to send [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] to the planet [[Abonshee]]. Their goal would be to contact with the locals, the [[Anointed People]], in the name of the Alliance, and obtain new sources of food. The Roughnecks sent the [[Green squad]], ferried in the ''[[Long Shot]]''.<ref name="TotG" />

The discussions were finally interrupted when the damaged [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Resurgence (Curich-class)|''Resurgence'']] landed on the planet. As [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] [[Battle of Abonshee|attacked]] local civilians, the [[Godking]] of the Anointed People [[Trisstan]] had its people join the Alliance.<ref name="TotG" />
